title: Dashboard sessions survive the restart an update makes; the button waits for the new revision
goal: Updating from the dashboard keeps it signed in and never offers a stale Update now
acceptance: Failing tests first: a session survives a server restart; the file holds only hashes, mode 0600
Rotating the admin token or revoking ends stored sessions, also after a restart
After Update started the button stays busy until the new revision answers
Owner updates from the dashboard and stays signed in
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-23 (owner decision a); independent security review before merge.
